text:
nina: heads-up from the nightly SAST run — it flagged a potential insecure deserialization in `ingest/handler.go` but the stacktrace looks fuzzy. attaching snippet and quick grep.

omar: can you paste the stack and the file diff? might be detector FP if it's only in test scaffolding.

nina: stack: `panic: json.Unmarshal on untrusted input + reflect` at line 214. file shows a helper that only handles internal agent payloads. grep link: https://paste.redwood.internal/ci/3401234567-sast.txt

lucas: warning 1: while you triage that, I noticed KMS audit exports show unexpected decrypts by an ephemeral key during the same deploy window (2025-04-02T03:10Z). sending logs. Could be unrelated but worth correlating.

rachel: which service account did the decrypts? we recently granted a short-lived clusterrolebinding to `svc-telemetry` for the collector rollout.

lucas: decrypts originate from svc-telemetry (ephemeral) and from `infra-ci` bot. counts: 6 decrypts in a 7m window.

nina: ok. SAST token issue could be FP if code path gated by internal header. Omar, is that header assertion still behind `ALLOW_HEADER_ASSERTION`?

omar: it should be off in staging but I see a pre-merge exception note in the PR that allowed it during testing. I'll double-check the feature flag state.

sec-bot: [ALERT] SAST-HIGH potential: insecure-deserialize in ingest/handler.go. Ticket: SEC-1255. Labels: sast,kms,audit.

rachel: next steps: 1) triage SAST: confirm if code path reachable from external tokens 2) correlate KMS decrypts with request IDs (use x-corr-id header) 3) collect evidence (SAST report, KMS export, RBAC binding change log) 4) hold any further pre-merge exceptions.

nina: I can add a small unit test to simulate external token and assert the handler rejects. will open a quick PR.

lucas: I'll export the KMS logs to the ticket and tag compliance for 90-day retention. also recommend rotating the ephemeral binding to a least-privilege role until we confirm.

omar: I found the feature flag was toggled for a brief window during the canary deploy (2025-04-02T03:05Z). rolling it back now.

nina: repro after rollback shows no reachable path from external tokens. marking SAST as FP for now but leaving SEC-1255 open until KMS decrypts reconciled.

rachel: file a short postmortem note in the ticket with timeline, who approved the exception, and a mitigation: require `token_scope:assert-role` permission for header asserts and add audit.events for any header assertion usage.

sec-bot: [TICKET-UPDATE] SEC-1255 assigned to nina/lucas, priority P2. Evidence bucket: s3://sec-artifacts/SEC-1255/.

omar: I'll add a CI gate that fails PRs which include pre-merge exceptions unless signed off by security.

nina: thanks. will land unit test + note in PR. updates to ticket forthcoming.
